hero.lead: I'm James — a BSIT student, full-stack developer, and AI automation builder. I design and ship end-to-end systems: interfaces, APIs, databases, and the automated workflows that connect them.

about.locationTag: 📍  Naic Cavite  Philippines — Open to internships & junior roles
paragraphs: I'm a **BSIT student** from the Philippines who builds complete software systems — not just interfaces. My focus sits at the intersection of **full-stack engineering** and **AI automation**: designing the data model, wiring the API, and letting intelligent workflows handle the repetitive parts.
My mission is simple — turn real, messy problems into software that people actually want to use. I care about clean architecture, sensible defaults, and interfaces that get out of the way.

Long term, I'm working toward a career building AI-driven products at a team that ships fast and cares about craft — starting with an internship or junior full-stack role where I can learn from senior engineers.
